findings.statement: The source packet comprises pmid-20979473, a single-case literature report measuring clinical response and molecular profiling in a lung adenocarcinoma patient treated with crizotinib. It directly measures the emergence of the ALK C1156Y variant at relapse and in vitro resistance assays, with applicability limited to a single patient cohort and in vitro models.

citations.quote: A 28 year-old patient with T4N3M1 stage lung adenocarcinoma harboring an EML4-ALK variant 1 fusion was treated with crizotinib after failing conventional therapy. The patient achieved a partial response, but progressed after 5 months of treatment. Molecular analysis at relapse identified C1156Y in the ALK kinase domain of the fusion at an allele frequency of 41.8%. This variant was undetected by Sanger sequencing in the tumor collected before crizotinib treatment. Cytotoxicity assays revealed Ba/F3 cells expressing EML4-ALK C1156Y were more resistant to crizontinib than those expressing
EML4-ALK wildtype. Immunoblot demonstrated crizontinib reduced tyrosine phosphorylation of the wildtype fusion, but not the EML4-ALK C1156Y fusion.
